S01.reference: SELECT c.id,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='paid' THEN o.amount ELSE 0 END),0) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.id

S02.reference: SELECT entity,value FROM (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY entity ORDER BY stamp DESC,id DESC) AS rn FROM events) WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY entity

S03.reference: WITH p AS (SELECT o.customer_id,SUM(p.amount) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id GROUP BY o.customer_id),r AS (SELECT o.customer_id,SUM(r.amount) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id JOIN refunds r ON r.payment_id=p.id GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT c.id,COALESCE(p.amount,0)-COALESCE(r.amount,0) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN p ON p.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN r ON r.customer_id=c.id ORDER BY c.id

S04.reference: WITH distinct_days AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,day FROM visits),g AS (SELECT user_id,day-ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY day) AS grp FROM distinct_days),s AS (SELECT user_id,COUNT(*) AS n FROM g GROUP BY user_id,grp) SELECT user_id,MAX(n) FROM s GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id

S05.reference: SELECT a.id,b.id,MIN(a.end,b.end)-MAX(a.start,b.start) FROM bookings a JOIN bookings b ON a.room=b.room AND a.id<b.id WHERE MIN(a.end,b.end)>MAX(a.start,b.start) ORDER BY a.id,b.id

S06.reference: SELECT DISTINCT v.user_id FROM events v JOIN events c ON c.user_id=v.user_id JOIN events b ON b.user_id=v.user_id WHERE v.kind='view' AND c.kind='cart' AND b.kind='buy' AND (v.stamp<c.stamp OR (v.stamp=c.stamp AND v.id<c.id)) AND (c.stamp<b.stamp OR (c.stamp=b.stamp AND c.id<b.id)) ORDER BY v.user_id
